任务：根据提供的【姜胡说杭州活动 AI众筹（正式群）】群聊天记录生成今日群日报，输出为风格固定、一致的HTML页面，适合截图分享

## 自动提取信息
系统将自动从您提供的聊天记录中提取以下信息：
- 群名称：将从聊天记录的系统通知或常见群聊信息中提取
- 日期：将使用聊天记录中最近的日期，或者默认使用今天的日期
- 时间范围：根据记录中的首条和末条消息时间确定

## 日报模式选择
- 日报模式：[完整版/简化版] (默认为完整版)
- 如果需要简化版，请在提交时注明"生成简化版日报"

## 简化版说明
如选择"简化版"，将只生成以下核心部分：
- 今日讨论热点（最多3个）
- 重要消息汇总
- 话唠榜（仅前3名）
- 简化版词云
日报内容更精简，适合快速浏览和分享。

## 聊天记录支持格式
支持以下多种常见格式：
- "[时间] 昵称：消息内容"
- "时间 - 昵称：消息内容"
- "昵称 时间：消息内容"
- 其他合理的时间和昵称分隔格式

如未能识别消息格式或未找到有效记录，将显示提示信息并尝试按最佳猜测处理。

## 输出要求

首次 h1 为“群名称 · 群聊日报”。词云使用一个 data-weight=5 主词、2–3 个 4 级大词，混合 3/2/1 级中小词；data-tone=0–6 指定类别配色。只填写词条文本和这两个属性，不写行内 style 或手工坐标。建议 18–24 个短词，极窄屏优先 12–16 个。重要程度没有精确词频时标明“主题关键词”；灰色辅助词不超过四分之一。禁止将所有词条设置为同样字号或粗体。
必须使用以下固定的HTML模板和CSS样式，仅更新内容部分，确保每次生成的页面风格完全一致。使用严格定义的深色科技风格。

布局约束：只更新内容，不修改模板 CSS/JS。首次打开固定深色。保留高对比云朵底色、居中弹窗及异常视口的文档流回退；三张二维码已内嵌原图，不替换、不重绘。

<style>

@supports selector(:has(*)){:root:has(#theme-light:checked){color-scheme:light;--bg-page:#f5f4ed;--bg-gradient:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%,#faf9f5 0%,#f5f4ed 80%);--bg-secondary:#faf9f5;--bg-tertiary:#f0eee6;--bg-card:#faf9f5;--bg-card-sub:#f0eee6;--border-color:#e8e6dc;--border-soft:#e5e3d8;--border-hover:#1B365D;--text-primary:#141413;--text-secondary:#3d3d3a;--text-muted:#6b6a64;--brand:#1B365D;--brand-dark:#12243e;--brand-tint:#EEF2F7;--tag-bg:#E4ECF5;--tag-text:#1B365D;--tv-gradient:linear-gradient(135deg,#0284c7 0%,#4338ca 50%,#7c3aed 100%);--accent-terracotta:#a64b35;--accent-olive:#50613a;--accent-ochre:#9e6d2a;--accent-teal:#21596b;--accent-violet:#6b5383;--shadow-card:0 4px 16px -2px rgba(27,54,93,.04),0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.02);--cloud-bg:#ece9df}}
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;transition:background-color .25s,border-color .25s,color .25s}
html{min-height:100%;background:var(--bg-page)}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg-page);color:var(--text-primary);font-family:"TsangerJinKai02","Source Han Serif SC","Noto Serif CJK SC","Songti SC","STSong",Charter,Georgia,serif;line-height:1.55;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.2pt}
#page{background:var(--bg-gradient);background-color:var(--bg-page);color:var(--text-primary);max-width:880px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px 16px 48px;min-height:100vh}
.visually-hidden{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
.qr-popup-state{display:none}
.gradient-text{background:var(--tv-gradient);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;display:inline-block}
header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;padding:26px 30px;background:var(--bg-secondary);margin-bottom:26px;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--border-color);border-bottom:2px dashed var(--border-color);box-shadow:var(--shadow-card)}

.btn-sponsor:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f43f5e,#fb7185);color:#fff;border-color:transparent;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(244,63,94,.35)}
.footer-meta-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(180px,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:18px;padding-bottom:18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft)}
.meta-card{background:var(--bg-card-sub);padding:10px 14px;border-radius:4px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;border:1px solid var(--border-color)}
.meta-label{font-size:11px;color:var(--text-muted);text-transform:uppercase;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif}
.meta-val{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-primary);font-weight:500;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif}
.footer-note{text-align:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-muted);margin-top:14px;line-height:1.5;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif}
.side-toc{position:fixed;top:90px;left:calc(50% + 460px);width:146px;background:var(--bg-secondary);border:1px solid var(--border-color);border-radius:8px;padding:14px 10px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-card);z-index:100;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif}
.toc-header{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text-muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.6px;margin-bottom:10px;padding-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.toc-indicator{width:5px;height:5px;background:var(--tv-gradient);border-radius:50%}
.toc-list{list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px}
.toc-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:4px;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-secondary);text-decoration:none;position:relative}
.toc-num{font-size:10px;color:var(--text-muted);font-family:'JetBrains Mono',Consolas,monospace}
.toc-link:hover{color:var(--brand);background:var(--bg-card-sub)}
.toc-link.active{color:var(--brand);background:var(--brand-tint);font-weight:600}
.toc-link.active::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:4px;bottom:4px;width:2.5px;background:var(--tv-gradient);border-radius:2px}
.back-to-top-btn{position:fixed;left:calc(50% + 513px);bottom:30px;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--bg-secondary);border:1px solid var(--border-color);color:var(--text-secondary);box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.25);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-decoration:none;z-index:998;transition:all .25s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}
.back-to-top-btn:hover{color:var(--brand);border-color:var(--brand);transform:translateY(-3px)}
.back-to-top-btn.hidden{opacity:0;pointer-events:none}
.report-qr-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:2147483000;isolation:isolate;background:rgba(20,20,19,.62);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:16px;padding:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-top)) max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right)) max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-bottom)) max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left));overflow:hidden;overscroll-behavior:contain}
#qr-donation-open:checked ~ #donation-modal,#qr-wechat-open:checked ~ #generic-qr-modal,.report-qr-overlay.is-open,.report-qr-overlay:target{display:flex}
html.report-qr-open,html.report-qr-open body{overflow:hidden;overscroll-behavior:none}

.report-qr-backdrop{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;display:block;cursor:pointer}
.report-qr-card{position:relative;z-index:1;display:block;visibility:visible;opacity:1;flex-shrink:1;width:100%;max-width:340px;max-height:calc(100vh - 32px);max-height:calc(100dvh - 32px);min-height:0;padding:22px;background:var(--bg-secondary,#fff);border:1px solid var(--border-color,#dedede);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 16px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.35);text-align:center;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;outline:none}
.modal-title{font-size:16px;font-weight:500;color:var(--text-primary);margin-bottom:14px}
.payment-tabs{display:flex;border:1px solid var(--border-color);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:14px;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif}
.pay-tab{flex:1;min-height:44px;touch-action:manipulation;padding:8px 10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;cursor:pointer;color:var(--text-muted);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px}
.qr-wrapper{max-width:100%;padding:10px;background:#fff;border-radius:6px;display:inline-block;margin-bottom:12px;border:1px solid var(--border-color)}
.qr-img{width:192px;max-width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1;display:block;object-fit:contain}
.qr-img-ali{display:none}
#pay-ali:checked ~ .payment-tabs .tab-ali{background:var(--bg-tertiary);color:#0284c7;border-bottom:2px solid #0284c7}
#pay-wx:checked ~ .payment-tabs .tab-wx{background:var(--bg-tertiary);color:#10b981;border-bottom:2px solid #10b981}
#pay-ali:checked ~ .qr-wrapper .qr-img-ali{display:block}
#pay-ali:checked ~ .qr-wrapper .qr-img-wx{display:none}
.modal-desc{font-size:13px;color:var(--text-secondary);margin-bottom:14px;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif}
.modal-close-btn{cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;min-height:44px;touch-action:manipulation;background:var(--bg-tertiary);color:var(--text-primary);border:1px solid var(--border-color);font-weight:500;padding:8px 14px;border-radius:4px;text-decoration:none;font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',Roboto,sans-serif}
.modal-close-btn:hover{border-color:var(--brand);color:var(--brand)}
.modal-close-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--brand);outline-offset:3px}
#pay-wx:focus-visible ~ .payment-tabs .tab-wx,#pay-ali:focus-visible ~ .payment-tabs .tab-ali{outline:2px solid var(--brand);outline-offset:-3px}
@media (max-height:540px){.report-qr-card{padding:16px}.qr-img{width:160px}.modal-title{margin-top:0;margin-bottom:10px}.payment-tabs{margin-bottom:10px}.modal-desc{margin-bottom:10px}}
@media (max-width:1220px){.side-toc{display:none}.back-to-top-btn{left:auto;right:20px;bottom:24px}}
@media (max-width:640px){
#page{padding:16px 12px 36px;font-size:14px}
header{padding:20px 16px;margin-bottom:16px;border-radius:8px}
h1{font-size:21px;line-height:1.35;margin-bottom:12px;word-break:break-word}
.meta-info{gap:8px 14px;font-size:12px}
section{padding:18px 14px;margin-bottom:16px;border-radius:8px}
h2{font-size:17px;margin-bottom:14px}
h3{font-size:15px}
.cloud-container{margin:0 auto;padding:6px 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;width:100%;min-width:0}
.cloud-wordcloud{max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:1.25;min-height:230px;margin:8px 0;padding:26px;gap:8px 10px}
.cloud-word{font-size:var(--cloud-font-size,14px)!important}
.cloud-word.hero-primary{font-weight:800}
.cloud-word.hero-word{font-weight:700}
.cloud-legend{margin-top:18px;gap:12px;font-size:11px}
.contact-buttons{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:8px}
.c-btn{justify-content:center;padding:8px;font-size:12px}
.footer-meta-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:8px}
.promo-card{padding:16px 14px}
footer{padding:20px 14px;margin-top:24px}
.footer-note{font-size:11px;line-height:1.6}
.back-to-top-btn{right:16px;bottom:20px;width:38px;height:38px}
}

/* A file preview may expose the full document as its viewport. Keep fallback in document flow. */
.report-qr-overlay.report-qr-inline,.report-qr-overlay:target:not(.is-open){position:static!important;inset:auto!important;width:auto!important;height:auto!important;max-width:880px;margin:16px auto;padding:16px;background:transparent;overflow:visible;isolation:auto}
.report-qr-inline .report-qr-backdrop,.report-qr-overlay:target:not(.is-open) .report-qr-backdrop{display:none}
.report-qr-inline .report-qr-card,.report-qr-overlay:target:not(.is-open) .report-qr-card{max-height:none!important}
/* Word-cloud hierarchy: dominant keywords, medium clusters and a light outer halo. */
.cloud-word{font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei","PingFang SC","Noto Sans CJK SC",sans-serif;font-weight:var(--cloud-weight,400)!important;color:var(--cloud-color,#38bdf8)!important;background:none!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:currentColor!important;letter-spacing:0;line-height:1.15;text-shadow:0 2px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.16)}
:root[data-theme="light"] .cloud-word{text-shadow:none}
.cloud-wordcloud{max-width:760px;aspect-ratio:1.95;min-height:270px}
@media(max-width:640px){.cloud-wordcloud{max-width:100%;aspect-ratio:1.35;min-height:230px}}
</style>
</head>

<header>
<div class="header-left">
<div class="header-tag-row"><div class="header-tag"><span class="dot"></span>群聊日常提炼</div></div>

<div class="meta-info">

<div class="meta-item"><span class="icon">💬</span><span>提取 [数量] 条消息</span></div>
<div class="meta-item"><span class="icon">👥</span><span>[数量] 位群友参与</span></div>
<div class="meta-item"><span class="icon">⏱️</span><span>[时间范围]</span></div>
</div>
</div>

<label for="theme-light" class="theme-toggle-btn btn-to-light" aria-label="切换到浅色模式"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="5"></circle><line x1="12" y1="1" x2="12" y2="3"></line><line x1="12" y1="21" x2="12" y2="23"></line><line x1="4.22" y1="4.22" x2="5.64" y2="5.64"></line><line x1="18.36" y1="18.36" x2="19.78" y2="19.78"></line><line x1="1" y1="12" x2="3" y2="12"></line><line x1="21" y1="12" x2="23" y2="12"></line><line x1="4.22" y1="19.78" x2="5.64" y2="18.36"></line><line x1="18.36" y1="5.64" x2="19.78" y2="4.22"></line></svg></label>
<label for="theme-light" class="theme-toggle-btn btn-to-dark" aria-label="切换回深色模式"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z"></path></svg></label>
</div>

<section class="word-cloud" id="sec-wordcloud">

</div>
</div>

</div>

</div>

<script>
(function(){
function layoutCloud(cloud){
var words=Array.from(cloud.querySelectorAll('.cloud-word'));
if(!words.length||cloud.clientWidth===0)return;
cloud.classList.remove('cloud-layout-ready');
var width=cloud.clientWidth,height=cloud.clientHeight,mobile=width<440;
cloud.style.setProperty('--cloud-unit',width/785+'px');
var palette=['#22d3ee','#38bdf8','#fb7185','#fbbf24','#a78bfa','#34d399','#b3b0bf'];
function weight(word){
var value=Number(word.getAttribute('data-weight'));
if(value>=1&&value<=5)return Math.round(value);
return word.classList.contains('hero-primary')?5:word.classList.contains('hero-word')?4:2;
}
words.forEach(function(word,index){
word.style.left='';word.style.top='';
word.style.removeProperty('--cloud-font-size');word.style.removeProperty('--cloud-angle');
var level=weight(word),tone=Number(word.getAttribute('data-tone'));
if(!word.hasAttribute('data-tone')||tone<0||tone>6)tone=level===5?0:index%7;
word.style.setProperty('--cloud-color',palette[tone]);
word.style.setProperty('--cloud-weight',level>=4?'700':level===3?'500':'400');
});
var ordered=words.slice().sort(function(a,b){return weight(b)-weight(a)||b.textContent.length-a.textContent.length||words.indexOf(a)-words.indexOf(b);});
cloud.classList.add('cloud-layout-ready');
var placements=null;
for(var attempt=0;attempt<25&&!placements;attempt++){
var boxes=[],failed=false,scale=1-attempt*.025;
for(var w=0;w<ordered.length;w++){
var word=ordered[w],level=weight(word);
var base=(mobile?[0,12,15,19,25,34]:[0,15,21,29,39,54])[level];
var font=Math.max(level===5?(mobile?23:30):12,base*scale);
word.style.setProperty('--cloud-font-size',font+'px');
while(word.offsetWidth>width*.78&&font>12){font-=.5;word.style.setProperty('--cloud-font-size',font+'px');}
var degrees=level===5?0:(mobile?[-8,6,-5,9,0,-7,4]:[-12,9,-7,12,0,-10,6])[w%7];
word.style.setProperty('--cloud-angle',degrees+'deg');
var radians=degrees*Math.PI/180,cos=Math.abs(Math.cos(radians)),sin=Math.abs(Math.sin(radians));
var ww=Math.ceil(word.offsetWidth*cos+word.offsetHeight*sin),hh=Math.ceil(word.offsetWidth*sin+word.offsetHeight*cos);
var anchors=[[.50,.43],[.29,.32],[.70,.32],[.48,.65]];
var target;
if(w<4&&level>=4)target=anchors[w];
else{
var angle=(w-4)*2.399963229728653-.9;
var radius=level===1?.82:level===2?.68:.48;
target=[.50+Math.cos(angle)*.43*radius,.49+Math.sin(angle)*.41*radius];
}
var found=null,gap=mobile?2:4;
for(var i=0;i<3200;i++){
var radius=Math.sqrt(i/3200),angle=i*2.399963229728653;
var x=width*target[0]+Math.cos(angle)*radius*width*.80;
var y=height*target[1]+Math.sin(angle)*radius*height*.80;
var dx=(Math.abs(x-width*.50)+ww/2+gap)/(width*.47);
var dy=(Math.abs(y-height*.49)+hh/2+gap)/(height*.46);
if(dx*dx+dy*dy>1)continue;
if(boxes.some(function(box){return Math.abs(x-box.x)<(ww+box.w)/2+gap&&Math.abs(y-box.y)<(hh+box.h)/2+gap;}))continue;
found={word:word,x:x,y:y,w:ww,h:hh};break;
}
if(!found){failed=true;break;}boxes.push(found);
}
if(!failed)placements=boxes;
}
if(placements){placements.forEach(function(box){box.word.style.left=box.x+'px';box.word.style.top=box.y+'px';});}
else{
cloud.classList.remove('cloud-layout-ready');
words.forEach(function(word){word.style.removeProperty('--cloud-angle');});
}
}
var cloudFrame=null;
function updateClouds(){if(cloudFrame!==null)cancelAnimationFrame(cloudFrame);cloudFrame=requestAnimationFrame(function(){cloudFrame=null;document.querySelectorAll('.cloud-wordcloud').forEach(layoutCloud);});}
updateClouds();window.addEventListener('resize',updateClouds);
if(document.fonts&&document.fonts.ready)document.fonts.ready.then(updateClouds);
if(window.ResizeObserver){var cloudObserver=new ResizeObserver(updateClouds);document.querySelectorAll('.cloud-wordcloud').forEach(function(cloud){cloudObserver.observe(cloud);});}

var root=document.documentElement,page=document.getElementById('page');
var themeSwitch=document.getElementById('theme-light');
function applyTheme(mode){
root.setAttribute('data-theme',mode);
if(themeSwitch)themeSwitch.checked=mode==='light';

}
applyTheme('dark');
if(themeSwitch)themeSwitch.addEventListener('change',function(){applyTheme(themeSwitch.checked?'light':'dark');});

var activeModal=null,lastTrigger=null,lastPointer=null,scrollX=0,scrollY=0,bodyStyle=null;
function stateFor(modal){return document.getElementById(modal.id==='donation-modal'?'qr-donation-open':'qr-wechat-open');}
function lockPage(){
scrollX=window.scrollX;scrollY=window.scrollY;
bodyStyle=document.body.getAttribute('style');
var gap=window.innerWidth-root.clientWidth;
var padding=parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.body).paddingRight)||0;
root.classList.add('report-qr-open');
if(gap>0)document.body.style.paddingRight=padding+gap+'px';
if(page)page.inert=true;
if(themeSwitch)themeSwitch.disabled=true;
}
function unlockPage(){
root.classList.remove('report-qr-open');
if(bodyStyle===null)document.body.removeAttribute('style');else document.body.setAttribute('style',bodyStyle);
if(page)page.inert=false;
if(themeSwitch)themeSwitch.disabled=false;
window.scrollTo(scrollX,scrollY);
}
function previewNeedsInline(){
var viewport=window.visualViewport;
var height=viewport&&viewport.height>0?viewport.height:window.innerHeight;
var screenHeight=window.screen&&(window.screen.availHeight||window.screen.height);
return !(height>0)||!!(screenHeight>0&&height>screenHeight*1.25);
}
function showInline(modal){
modal.classList.add('report-qr-inline');
modal.removeAttribute('style');
modal.querySelector('.report-qr-card').style.maxHeight='none';
modal.querySelector('.report-qr-card').setAttribute('aria-modal','false');
if(root.classList.contains('report-qr-open'))unlockPage();
requestAnimationFrame(function(){modal.scrollIntoView({block:'center',behavior:'auto'});});
}
function positionCard(){
if(!activeModal)return;
if(activeModal.classList.contains('report-qr-inline'))return;
if(previewNeedsInline()){showInline(activeModal);return;}
var card=activeModal.querySelector('.report-qr-card'),viewport=window.visualViewport;
var height=viewport&&viewport.height>0?viewport.height:window.innerHeight;
var width=viewport&&viewport.width>0?viewport.width:window.innerWidth;
activeModal.style.top=(viewport?viewport.offsetTop:0)+'px';
activeModal.style.left=(viewport?viewport.offsetLeft:0)+'px';
activeModal.style.width=width+'px';activeModal.style.height=height+'px';
activeModal.style.right='auto';activeModal.style.bottom='auto';
card.style.maxHeight=Math.max(44,height-32)+'px';
}
function closeModal(){
if(!activeModal)return;
var modal=activeModal,trigger=lastTrigger;
stateFor(modal).checked=false;
if(location.hash==='#'+modal.id){try{history.replaceState(history.state,'',location.href.split('#')[0]);}catch(e){}}
var wasLocked=root.classList.contains('report-qr-open');
modal.classList.remove('is-open','report-qr-inline');modal.removeAttribute('style');modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
activeModal=null;lastTrigger=null;lastPointer=null;
if(wasLocked)unlockPage();
if(trigger&&document.contains(trigger))trigger.focus({preventScroll:true});
updateNavigation();
}
function openModal(modal,trigger,pointer){
if(activeModal===modal)return;
if(activeModal)closeModal();
lastTrigger=trigger||document.activeElement;lastPointer=pointer||null;
activeModal=modal;
var inline=previewNeedsInline();
if(!inline)lockPage();
stateFor(modal).checked=true;
modal.classList.add('is-open');modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
var card=modal.querySelector('.report-qr-card');card.scrollTop=0;
card.setAttribute('aria-modal',inline?'false':'true');
if(inline)showInline(modal);else positionCard();
try{card.focus({preventScroll:true});}catch(e){}
}
document.querySelectorAll('.report-qr-overlay').forEach(function(modal){
modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');stateFor(modal).checked=false;
stateFor(modal).addEventListener('change',function(){if(this.checked)openModal(modal,null,null);else if(activeModal===modal)closeModal();});
modal.querySelectorAll('[data-modal-close]').forEach(function(control){control.addEventListener('click',function(e){e.preventDefault();closeModal();});});
modal.addEventListener('touchmove',function(e){if(!modal.querySelector('.report-qr-card').contains(e.target))e.preventDefault();},{passive:false});
});
document.querySelectorAll('.btn-wechat,.btn-sponsor').forEach(function(trigger){
trigger.addEventListener('click',function(e){
var modal=document.getElementById(trigger.getAttribute('aria-controls'));
if(modal){try{openModal(modal,trigger,e);e.preventDefault();}catch(error){
if(root.classList.contains('report-qr-open'))unlockPage();
if(page)page.inert=false;
modal.classList.add('is-open');modal.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');showInline(modal);
}}
});
});
document.querySelectorAll('label[role="button"]').forEach(function(control){
control.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Enter'||e.key===' '){e.preventDefault();control.click();}});
});
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
if(!activeModal)return;
if(e.key==='Escape'){e.preventDefault();closeModal();return;}
if(e.key!=='Tab'||activeModal.classList.contains('report-qr-inline'))return;
var controls=Array.from(activeModal.querySelectorAll('a[href],button,input,select,textarea,[tabindex]')).filter(function(control){return !control.disabled&&control.tabIndex>=0&&control.getClientRects().length>0&&(control.type!=='radio'||control.checked);});
var first=controls[0],last=controls[controls.length-1];
if(!first){e.preventDefault();return;}
if(e.shiftKey&&(document.activeElement===first||controls.indexOf(document.activeElement)===-1)){e.preventDefault();last.focus();}
else if(!e.shiftKey&&(document.activeElement===last||controls.indexOf(document.activeElement)===-1)){e.preventDefault();first.focus();}
});
window.addEventListener('resize',positionCard);
if(window.visualViewport){window.visualViewport.addEventListener('resize',positionCard);window.visualViewport.addEventListener('scroll',positionCard);}

var btt=document.getElementById('back-to-top');
function updateNavigation(){
if(activeModal)return;
var y=window.scrollY||root.scrollTop;
if(btt)btt.classList.toggle('hidden',y<=300);
var cur='';document.querySelectorAll('section[id],#sec-producer').forEach(function(s){if(y>=s.offsetTop-120)cur=s.id;});
document.querySelectorAll('.toc-link').forEach(function(l){l.classList.toggle('active',l.getAttribute('href')==='#'+cur);});
}
window.addEventListener('scroll',updateNavigation,{passive:true});
document.querySelectorAll('.toc-link').forEach(function(l){l.addEventListener('click',function(e){var target=document.getElementById(l.getAttribute('href').slice(1));if(target){e.preventDefault();window.scrollTo({top:target.offsetTop-24,behavior:'smooth'});}});});
function modalFromHash(){var modal=document.getElementById(location.hash.slice(1));return modal&&modal.classList.contains('report-qr-overlay')?modal:null;}
window.addEventListener('hashchange',function(){var modal=modalFromHash();if(modal)openModal(modal,null,null);else if(activeModal)closeModal();});
updateNavigation();var initialModal=modalFromHash();if(initialModal)openModal(initialModal,null,null);
})();
</script>
